# Version 4.150.1
> **Skia m150 bug fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 refreshes the bundled Skia m150 engine with two focused upstream bug fixes. It corrects clipped render-pass stencil checks and prevents a use-after-free when deserializing corrupt Slug buffers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped render-pass bounds checked correctly** — Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))
- **Corrupt Slug deserialization made safe** — Fixes a use-after-free and possible wild or double free when a corrupt Slug buffer fails deserialization. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

Updates the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp from 14.2.1 to 14.2.1.1.
